name: action-tiles
title: Action tiles
description: The things people do most as a grid of tiles: icon, label, shortcut hint, real links or buttons, and a disabled reason in a tooltip that keeps focus.
docs: The shortcut is a hint: bind the keys yourself. A disabled tile stays in the tab order with aria-disabled and explains itself in a tooltip and, on touch screens where there is no hover, in place of its description (a dense tile shows it under the label). Pass icons as elements, for example `<IconFilePlus />`.
